Yo welcome MMO-Enjoyers,
I played over 1.000 hours of Cleric in Taiwan in both PVE and PVP and you just found my Min-Max Cleric Guide. On Global we managed to hit 2,2k Gearscore in 3 Days and reached Rank 1 in 1vs1 Arena and Abyss simultaenously. Here is going to be your go to source for any High Ranked Cleric Content of Aion 2 Global. Like all my Guides it will be regularly updated after every Patchnotes and everything is self tested or in terms of dps optimization calculated. As always I am offering an unofficial support if you comment below any Youtube Video (topics dont have to match) I will answer your question within 24 hours. Maintaining a Guide of this standard takes a lot of effort, but what doesnt take a lot of effort is giving the Guide a Heart, just 1 click for you but helps me out tremendously.

Daevion Boards: [Video Guide Link]

New Ariel Boards according to Patch 21.10 have been added.
This System is designed to be fully maxed out at some point, so under the Daevion Board Tab I made you an early game board that is giving max value with least points spend and as requested I updated on a Mid Version so you know better what to fill up afterwards. But you need to understand some general rules when you level your board. You wanna reach the orange dps Highlights as fast as possible and along the way you wanna pick up those skills right here: Judgment Thunder -> Earth's Retribution -> Condemnation -> Divine Aura -> Chain of Torment. The only Healing Skill you wanna focus on is Healing Light as this needs to be Lvl 16 asap so you can do ur role properly in Dungeons. Passives u only pick up along the way no focus on them or going out of line for them. Once you reached the state in the Board you finish by doing all active skills first (Lightning Scatter Shot excluded) and then all passives based on the upgrade priority in the Skill Tab.
Pet System:

While not giving any Gearscore the Pet System is still one of the most powerful sources for your combat power in the game. It is build defining. Since we wanna run a Block based Build. This is one of our major ways of getting it. On Global we will have lvl 3 pet max but the overall rule stays the same in tersm of upgrading. Important here is that you don't farm 1 pet to lvl 3 and then the next one and so on, if u do this u waste so much early game potential.

Genus Insight is the second way you will get stats out of pets, here its important to understand to only roll/analyze with colored crystals and save the rainbow crystals to 1st priority Special and 2ndly even out the color u get the least from naturally. Dont always roll down to zero, once u have a good roll for your level only roll if u get enough ressources to level up and have the chance to get a good roll again, otherwise u lose out on power and ur progress is not linear its up and down up and down. Once ur Genus Insight reaches lvl 9 u unlocked heroic tier. Now you can actually start setting it up prior to this u never use the lock cause every roll with a line locked gets more expensive.
Pantheon: [Video Guide Link]

Here you will unlock secondary stats its a bit complicated to get all the names so here is a priority order: Time > Illusion > Freedom > Life > Justice > Destruction > Wisdom > Death> Space > Destiny
Ur Main priority here is completing Nightmare Zikels as soon as u reach 2400 GS to unlock the Colossus: Zikel's Apparition (Bound) which gives u 45 Time 45 Destruction and 45 Justice.
You can also get a unique Barkama Statue by killing it 10 times in Conquest mode, do not use ur odlye energy for this on ur main plz its a waste.

Skills:

You will find the Leveling Priority and the full Skills Rotation including animation cancel techniques and macros in the Skill tab on the top row of the

tips.title: Skill Set Cleric PVE MrRosaPony
tips.text:
Your Rotation:

Important for Ludra u have to take Ress and u are replacing Noble Aura with it but if you have a Chanter u remove Light of Protection like always.

• You will toggle on ur Light of Protection

• Then use ur macro this will automatically debuff the enemy and buff yourself. It then follows up spamming ur main 2 Dmg Skills Condemnation and Judgement Thunder

• Bolt should only be used if u actually need the burst in terms of raw parsing dps its worse then ur macro.

• The same goes for Lightning Strike Scattershot its a bait and actually does lower dps then ur macro.

• Heals should never be in the Macro and always be pressed individually as they will lower ur dps. If you want it more convenient you can also include Skill Slot 10 with the Spam Heals to the macro but ibe aware this is suboptimal.

• When ur running low on Mana in the earlygame just hold down LMB as well, in the lategame when ur mana issues are resolved you will actually deal more dps again with the macro spam then with the inclusion of LMB.

tips.title: Skill Set Cleric PVP MrRosaPony
tips.text:
Your Rotation:
• Unlike in PVE in PVP Control and timing of your Skills become much more important.

• Light of Protection also stays toogle on in PVP

• For full Control you will run only chain of torment and judgement thunder in the macro for dps and for sustain here you should have the Slot 10 included

• Debuffs like earth punishment and voice of doom need to be pressed when the enemies cleanse skills are on cooldown, use the weaker once to bait them out and then use earth punishment to guarantee the condemnation spam and voice of doom to ensure the enemy can't fully heal through ur attack

• Defiance timing is essential use it when u can swing a fight and you get cced while tracking ur enemies CC skills cooldowns so ur not getting instantly hit with a follow up

• Salvation Stigma is ur OH SHIT Button and once u have it at lvl 5 with the 100% increased Healing you can get back to full health so timing it at low health doing a full hp swing and reapplying pressure then is the way to go

• Overall in PVP if u die its 9 out of 10 times cause u didnt manage ur cooldowns and the enemies cc correctly, if ur struggeling with this join my Stream and watch me do 1vs1 Arena there you learn the basics the best.

PvE

While Leveling
• Try to complete the green quests, sealed dungeons, and fortresses along your way before reaching max level. (You will have a harder time completing this content if you rush straight to max level.)

• Collect feathers to reach level 30 at the Monolith and level 20 at the Abyss Monolith.

• Upgrade your belt and amulet to Unique (yellow) +0, if possible. (Upgrading them further becomes expensive.)

Once you reach level 45, the goal is to reach 1400 GS to run Vakron and/or Uruguru. Your build will also depend on the equipment you can obtain while farming. This allows you to make the most efficient use of your Odyle Energies. You can also run the previous dungeons if you prefer to take your time!
If you're missing some item level to reach the requirement, you can increase your yellow equipment from +5 to +10 and use lower-grade Mana Stones on certain pieces of equipment.

1600 GS

Complete the Transcendences to obtain Arcana and reach 1900 GS.
Adjust your equipment depending on the loot you get from Vakron, but you can also run Uruguru to fill in the gaps more easily!

1900 GS

Level 2 Transcendences are unlocked, allowing you to obtain better Arcana.

2100 GS

This is where things really start!
Complete the Kromede and Ferocious Conquests to obtain their gear and start upgrading your weapons, armor, and accessories.

2300 GS

Level 3 Transcendences are unlocked, allowing you to obtain even better Arcana.

2600 GS

Level 4 Transcendences are unlocked.
We’re starting to collect Gold Cards. Check the Arcane tab (2100+ build) to see which skills I recommend prioritizing.
The skills on your equipment should be adjusted according to your skill levels, thanks to the Arcana system. (You need to reach the required level to unlock the 3rd skill specialization slot.)

2800 GS

Defeat Ludra!

Depending on your equipment, you will need at least Nuakum and Kromede gear. However, crafted gear would be the most suitable option, especially when adding PvE Potentials.
This is the optimized progression path, based on in-game experience and what many players recommend as an efficient progression route.

Of course, you can also complete all the content one step at a time and simply follow the story at your own pace.

PvP

It is entirely possible to use dungeon equipment for PvP.
You should prioritize content that rewards Abyss Points in order to start purchasing cosmetics from the Abyss Shop. These cosmetics provide passive PvP stats (you only need to own them; you don't have to equip them).
You should also work on your Azphel Daevanion.
You will need to use Potentials to obtain PvP stats on your highest-item-level equipment, preferably on your craft items.

🇫🇷
Pour le PvE

Pendant le leveling

• Essayer de faire les quêtes vertes, donjons scellés et forteresse sur votre chemin avant le niveau max (de préférence, vous aurez plus de difficulté à faire le contenu si vous rushez le niveau maximum tout de suite).

• Ramasser les plumes pour monter niveau 30 au monolithe et niveau 20 au monolithe des abysses.

• Améliorer la ceinture et l'amulette en unique (jaune) niveau 0, si possible (plus devient cher).

Une fois le lvl 45 atteint, l'objectif est de monter à 1400GS pour faire Vakron et/ou Uruguru, le build dépend également des équipements que vous pouvez drop pendant le farm. Cela permet d'optimiser l'utilisation des énergies d'odyles. Vous pouvez très bien faire les donjons précédents si vous souhaitez prendre votre temps !
S'il vous manque du ilevel pour l'atteindre, vous pouvez ajuster en montant les équipement jaunes de +5 à +10 et en utilisant des pierres de mana inférieures sur certains équipements.

1600GS

Faire les transcendances pour acquérir des arcanes et monter 1900GS. À gérer en fonction de l'équipement looté sur Vakron, mais il est possible de faire Uruguru pour compléter plus facilement !

New Ariel Boards according to Patch 21.10 have been added.
This System is designed to be fully maxed out at some point, so under the Daevion Board Tab I made you an early game board that is giving max value with least points spend and as requested I updated on a Mid Version so you know better what to fill up afterwards. But you need to understand some general rules when you level your board. You wanna reach the orange dps Highlights as fast as possible and along the way you wanna pick up those skills right here: Judgment Thunder -> Earth's Retribution -> Condemnation -> Divine Aura -> Chain of Torment. The only Healing Skill you wanna focus on is Healing Light as this needs to be Lvl 16 asap so you can do ur role properly in Dungeons. Passives u only pick up along the way no focus on them or going out of line for them. Once you reached the state in the Board you finish by doing all active skills first (Lightning Scatter Shot excluded) and then all passives based on the upgrade priority in the Skill Tab.
Pet System:

While not giving any Gearscore the Pet System is still one of the most powerful sources for your combat power in the game. It is build defining. Since we wanna run a Block based Build. This is one of our major ways of getting it. On Global we will have lvl 3 pet max but the overall rule stays the same in tersm of upgrading. Important here is that you don't farm 1 pet to lvl 3 and then the next one and so on, if u do this u waste so much early game potential.

Genus Insight is the second way you will get stats out of pets, here its important to understand to only roll/analyze with colored crystals and save the rainbow crystals to 1st priority Special and 2ndly even out the color u get the least from naturally. Dont always roll down to zero, once u have a good roll for your level only roll if u get enough ressources to level up and have the chance to get a good roll again, otherwise u lose out on power and ur progress is not linear its up and down up and down. Once ur Genus Insight reaches lvl 9 u unlocked heroic tier. Now you can actually start setting it up prior to this u never use the lock cause every roll with a line locked gets more expensive.
Pantheon: [Video Guide Link]

Here you will unlock secondary stats its a bit complicated to get all the names so here is a priority order: Time > Illusion > Freedom > Life > Justice > Destruction > Wisdom > Death> Space > Destiny
Ur Main priority here is completing Nightmare Zikels as soon as u reach 2400 GS to unlock the Colossus: Zikel's Apparition (Bound) which gives u 45 Time 45 Destruction and 45 Justice.
You can also get a unique Barkama Statue by killing it 10 times in Conquest mode, do not use ur odlye energy for this on ur main plz its a waste.

Skills:

tips.title: Skill Set Cleric PVP MrRosaPony
tips.text:
Your Rotation:
• Unlike in PVE in PVP Control and timing of your Skills become much more important.

• Light of Protection also stays toogle on in PVP

• For full Control you will run only chain of torment and judgement thunder in the macro for dps and for sustain here you should have the Slot 10 included

• Debuffs like earth punishment and voice of doom need to be pressed when the enemies cleanse skills are on cooldown, use the weaker once to bait them out and then use earth punishment to guarantee the condemnation spam and voice of doom to ensure the enemy can't fully heal through ur attack

• Defiance timing is essential use it when u can swing a fight and you get cced while tracking ur enemies CC skills cooldowns so ur not getting instantly hit with a follow up

• Salvation Stigma is ur OH SHIT Button and once u have it at lvl 5 with the 100% increased Healing you can get back to full health so timing it at low health doing a full hp swing and reapplying pressure then is the way to go

• Overall in PVP if u die its 9 out of 10 times cause u didnt manage ur cooldowns and the enemies cc correctly, if ur struggeling with this join my Stream and watch me do 1vs1 Arena there you learn the basics the best.

Defeat Ludra!

Depending on your equipment, you will need at least Nuakum and Kromede gear. However, crafted gear would be the most suitable option, especially when adding PvE Potentials.
This is the optimized progression path, based on in-game experience and what many players recommend as an efficient progression route.

Of course, you can also complete all the content one step at a time and simply follow the story at your own pace.

PvP

It is entirely possible to use dungeon equipment for PvP.
You should prioritize content that rewards Abyss Points in order to start purchasing cosmetics from the Abyss Shop. These cosmetics provide passive PvP stats (you only need to own them; you don't have to equip them).
You should also work on your Azphel Daevanion.
You will need to use Potentials to obtain PvP stats on your highest-item-level equipment, preferably on your craft items.

$join.$t: PvP-билд с Questlog: №{rank} по популярности среди PvP-билдов класса, автор {author}. Стадий: {stages} — выберите целевую.

$join:
SERAPH ETERNAL - our own Cleric build from level 45 / 1200 GS to endgame. Healer first, but every attack heals the party, refunds mana and cuts cooldowns.
WHAT'S OURS: skills, specializations, stigmas, macros, skill priority, every manastone/soulstone, every substat and Philosopher's Stone, theostones, titles and both Daevanion boards. The only thing kept from the original template (Alwera / marx0310) is which gear pieces drop at each stage - those follow the game's dungeon progression, and we checked the top-tier weapon (Splendent Wise Dragon Lord Mace) against Ludra's Fatal Mace: same Attack at max enhancement, plus extra Damage Boost and Attack, so it stays.
SKILLS: every stage uses the Seraph Eternal skill build (core loop, 4 macros, skill priority).
OPTIMIZATION RULES:
• Heals scale with Attack (Healing Enhancement turns Attack into Heal Boost), so Attack is the #1 stat.

• - Weapon + Guard stones: Damage Boost, Weapon Damage Boost, Critical Damage Boost, Attack.

• - Armor stones: 3x Attack + 1x HP. Accessory stones: 4x Attack.

tips.text:
SERAPH ETERNAL - our own Cleric build from level 45 / 1200 GS to endgame. Healer first, but every attack heals the party, refunds mana and cuts cooldowns.
WHAT'S OURS: skills, specializations, stigmas, macros, skill priority, every manastone/soulstone, every substat and Philosopher's Stone, theostones, titles and both Daevanion boards. The only thing kept from the original template (Alwera / marx0310) is which gear pieces drop at each stage - those follow the game's dungeon progression, and we checked the top-tier weapon (Splendent Wise Dragon Lord Mace) against Ludra's Fatal Mace: same Attack at max enhancement, plus extra Damage Boost and Attack, so it stays.
SKILLS: every stage uses the Seraph Eternal skill build (core loop, 4 macros, skill priority).
OPTIMIZATION RULES:
• Heals scale with Attack (Healing Enhancement turns Attack into Heal Boost), so Attack is the #1 stat.

• - Weapon + Guard stones: Damage Boost, Weapon Damage Boost, Critical Damage Boost, Attack.

• - Armor stones: 3x Attack + 1x HP. Accessory stones: 4x Attack.

• - Armor/accessory substats: Healing Enhancement Lv+1 and Radiant Benediction Lv+1 wherever allowed, then Attack increase %, Double Chance, Multi-hit, Crit Damage, Combat Speed, Incoming Heal, Endurance, Attack, Crit.

• - Rings: Condemnation, Chain of Torment, Healing Light, Radiant Recovery skill levels.

• - Theostones: Tiamat's Counterstrike on weapon (AoE proc), Triniel's Rationality on guard (single-target proc).

• - Daevanion: started from a full board and removed the least useful nodes first (Crit Hit Resist, Max MP, Heal Block, Defense) while keeping every node connected. Result vs the old board at the same 474 points: Attack Bonus 42 -> 135, Crit 110 -> 185, HP 3300 -> 3900, every skill still +4.

• STAGE 1 - lvl 45 -> 1400 GS (you are here): Intermediate stones, Attack 577 -> 924, GS 1594. Goal: unlock Vakron / Uruguru.

• STAGE 2 - 1400 -> 1900 GS: Vakron/Aulamus gear, Superior stones, full substats. GS 2216.

• STAGE 3 - 2100+ GS: Kromede/Nuakum gear +15. GS 2934. Ludra at ~2800.

• DREAM: crafted Wise Dragon Lord gear +20 with the Endgame Max Daevanion (all 4 PvE boards full). GS 3691.

• TITLES: Stage 1 = Unbound by Genus / Dutiful / Not to Be Missed. Stage 2 = Teleportation Specialist / Saint of Verteron / Through Hell and Back. Stage 3+ = Playing God / Dutiful or Saint of Verteron / Empty Closet.

• PLAYSTYLE: just HOLD two macros. HOLD Judgment Loop for damage (it also heals the party through Radiant Benediction), HOLD Seraph Heals when HP drops. Heals sit on keys 1-3 for manual spam. Light of Protection and Bolt stay manual.

tips.title: Seraph Eternal - Unkillable Healer
tips.text:
SERAPH ETERNAL - the healer that hits back. Every attack heals the party (Radiant Benediction), refunds mana and cuts cooldowns.
HOW TO PLAY - just 2 keys to HOLD:
1) HOLD - Judgment Loop (macro set 1): Earth Punishment > DAMAGE LINE > Debilitating Mark > DAMAGE LINE > Divine Aura > DAMAGE LINE > Earth's Retribution. In Aion 2 a macro step can only use the BOTTOM skill of a skill line, and it fires that whole line - so each 'Condemnation' step is really the damage line (Condemnation > Scattershot > Chain of Torment > Judgment Thunder). Hold it and it loops; anything on cooldown is skipped.
2) HOLD - Seraph Heals (macro set 2, for heal-heavy bosses): Benevolence > HEAL LINE x3 > Earth's Retribution. The heal line is Absolution > Radiant Recovery > Light of Regeneration > Healing Light, so every step fires your best ready heal, and the Earth's Retribution filler keeps Radiant Benediction healing the party.
20 ms delays. Lock a target before holding. Delete blank macro steps.
KEPT OFF THE MACROS ON PURPOSE: Bolt (charge skill - a macro releases it uncharged), Light of Protection (toggle - looping would turn it off), Defiance (save it for stuns).
SKILL BAR (skill lines - bottom row fires first, top row is the filler): KEY 1 = HEAL BUTTON, just spam it: Absolution (bottom) > Radiant Recovery > Light of Regeneration > Healing Light (top). KEY 12 / right mouse = DAMAGE BUTTON: Condemnation (bottom) > Scattershot > Chain of Torment > Judgment Thunde
